title: Welcome to Voidburn
tagline: Vanilla OSRS, with slight QoL. 24/7 hosted. Bilingual community.
aboutBody: We are a small, friendly community. We aim to give a Vanilla OSRS experience with no custom content, tweaking a few things, mainly balance changes thought out for a massive MMO or to compensate for the existence of bots. There are both spanish and english speakers in our community, and everyone is welcome.
changesBody: Minigame grinds are faster. Combat training methods are a bit faster than vanilla. Almost all drop rates are the same as official OSRS.
whatsNewBody: We just launched this MOTD thingy. Neat, huh? There is a skinless corpse under my bed.
